title: Scope.
officialText:
These provisions shall govern the materials, design, application, construction and installation of foam plastic, foam
plastic insulation, plastic veneer, interior plastic finish and trim, and light-transmitting plastics. See Chapter 14 for requirements for
exterior wall finish and trim.
SECTION BC 2602
DEFINITIONS
